name: GamerX Arcade — Games on Every New Tab
description: A whole arcade on your new tab, with a dozen games that play offline. New games every week. No sign-up, no ads, no data collected.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; frame-src 'self' https://gamerx.live; connect-src 'self' https://gamerx.live; img-src 'self' https://gamerx.live data: blob:; media-src 'self' https://gamerx.live data: blob:; font-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
